dialogues.en: I was cleaning my room, squinting in the warm spring sun.
dialogues.text: I was cleaning my room, squinting in the warm spring sun.

dialogues.jp:
うららかな春の日差しに目を細めながら、俺は
玄関でぼうっとしていた。
dialogues.en:
"Huh, it doesn't feel like school has started if you don't
attend the entrance ceremony, or the orientation."
dialogues.text:
"Huh, it doesn't feel like school has started if you don't
attend the entrance ceremony, or the orientation."

dialogues.jp:
音夢が吐き出した桜の花びらを、外に捨ててき
た後だった。
dialogues.en: I mumbled as I looked outside of the window.
dialogues.text: I mumbled as I looked outside of the window.

dialogues.jp: 「…………あー、だるい」
dialogues.en: Today's Thursday.
dialogues.text: Today's Thursday.

dialogues.jp:
あれ以来、猛烈な痛みが襲ってくるようなこと
がないのは嬉しかったが、そんなことで喜んで
はいられなかった。
dialogues.en: It has been four days since high school started.
dialogues.text: It has been four days since high school started.

dialogues.jp: 音夢が桜の花びらを吐き出す──。
dialogues.en: Which means Nemu and I have been absent for four days.
dialogues.text: Which means Nemu and I have been absent for four days.

dialogues.jp:
尋常じゃない事態になっていると、頭ではわかっ
ている。
dialogues.en:
"Well...... Nemu's taking her time off, so it doesn't
matter."
dialogues.text:
"Well...... Nemu's taking her time off, so it doesn't
matter."

dialogues.jp:
だけど、それを心が受け入れることが出来なかっ
た。
dialogues.en: I shook my head, trying not to think negatively.
dialogues.text: I shook my head, trying not to think negatively.

dialogues.jp: 頭のどこかが｛まひ／麻痺｝している。
dialogues.en: "I don't have anything I can do at this point."
dialogues.text: "I don't have anything I can do at this point."

dialogues.jp:
「こんな風に……音夢に花びらを見せないよう
　にしてるのがその証拠だよなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Yep. This is a perfect day to air the bedding."
dialogues.text: "Yep. This is a perfect day to air the bedding."

dialogues.jp: それで根本的な解決が出来る訳じゃないのに。
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.en:
I turned around and found Nemu standing behind me. I'd told
her to go back to her room since I was cleaning my room.
dialogues.text:
I turned around and found Nemu standing behind me. I'd told
her to go back to her room since I was cleaning my room.

dialogues.jp: 呟いた時だった。
dialogues.en:
She was standing with her hand on her forehead, and looked
in pain.
dialogues.text:
She was standing with her hand on her forehead, and looked
in pain.

dialogues.jp: 桜の花びらが落ちてきた。
dialogues.en:
"Hey, you have to be in bed if you aren't feeling well. Or,
are you hungry?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, you have to be in bed if you aren't feeling well. Or,
are you hungry?"

dialogues.en: Nemu hugged me as she looked restless.
dialogues.text: Nemu hugged me as she looked restless.

dialogues.jp:
全部捨ててきたと思ったんだが……どうやら、
残っていたらしい。
dialogues.en: "...What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "...What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp: 「肩に付いてたのか……？」
dialogues.en: She put her ear on my chest.
dialogues.text: She put her ear on my chest.

dialogues.jp: 呟くと──。
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.jp: はらり……。
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: またひとつ、落ちてくる。
dialogues.en:
"I can't give up the possibility of this being a dream
though."
dialogues.text:
"I can't give up the possibility of this being a dream
though."

dialogues.en: We held each other tightly.
dialogues.text: We held each other tightly.

dialogues.jp: 「どういうことだ？」
dialogues.en: "Someone else's dream?"
dialogues.text: "Someone else's dream?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は腕を組んで考えた。
dialogues.en: I gasped.
dialogues.text: I gasped.

dialogues.jp: チリン……。
dialogues.en:
If we're sharing our consciousness, then she could be
dreaming my dream.
dialogues.text:
If we're sharing our consciousness, then she could be
dreaming my dream.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の首に着けられた鈴が鳴った。
dialogues.en: But, I don't remember having any dreams last night.
dialogues.text: But, I don't remember having any dreams last night.

dialogues.jp: 音夢が起きたらしい。
dialogues.en:
Does it mean Nemu's dreaming someone else's dream by
herself?
dialogues.text:
Does it mean Nemu's dreaming someone else's dream by
herself?

dialogues.jp: 「考え事してる場合じゃないな」
dialogues.en: "Because it's a dream."
dialogues.text: "Because it's a dream."

dialogues.jp:
俺はのそりと立ち上がって、音夢の部屋に向かっ
た。
dialogues.en: The world of dreams is quite scary if you think about it.
dialogues.text: The world of dreams is quite scary if you think about it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、どこ行ってたの……？」
dialogues.en: Dreams -- don't always have a happy ending.
dialogues.text: Dreams -- don't always have a happy ending.

dialogues.jp: 不安そうな、音夢の声。
dialogues.en:
Things happen that are against all the laws of physics, and
criminal acts won't be punished.
dialogues.text:
Things happen that are against all the laws of physics, and
criminal acts won't be punished.

dialogues.jp: その弱々しい響きに、胸が痛くなる。
dialogues.en:
People die, people get killed, and sometimes the one who's
dreaming it ends up dead.
dialogues.text:
People die, people get killed, and sometimes the one who's
dreaming it ends up dead.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、な」
dialogues.en: And then they come back to life like nothing has happened.
dialogues.text: And then they come back to life like nothing has happened.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "It sure is a dream...... that's right, but..."
dialogues.text: "It sure is a dream...... that's right, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……生理現象だよ」
dialogues.en:
"Niisan...... Why do guys have pornographic dreams like
that?"
dialogues.text:
"Niisan...... Why do guys have pornographic dreams like
that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうだったんだ。ごめん……」
dialogues.en:
"I said why do guys have pornographic dreams? Isn't it
abnormal?"
dialogues.text:
"I said why do guys have pornographic dreams? Isn't it
abnormal?"

dialogues.jp: 本当のことを言えるわけない。
dialogues.en: "I don't know."
dialogues.text: "I don't know."

dialogues.jp: だから、嘘を吐いたのに。
dialogues.en: "Don't look at me like I'm some kind of symbol for mankind."
dialogues.text: "Don't look at me like I'm some kind of symbol for mankind."

dialogues.jp: 「何で謝るんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I don't."
dialogues.text: "I don't."

dialogues.jp:
「むしろ、ずっと一緒にいてやるって言ったの
　に、離れてた俺の方が悪いじゃないか」
dialogues.en: I smiled wryly as I lifted my bedding off my bed.
dialogues.text: I smiled wryly as I lifted my bedding off my bed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それとこれとは別だよ。……兄さんがそう言っ
　てくれるのは嬉しいけど」
dialogues.en: "You can't cheat on me even in your dream, okay?"
dialogues.text: "You can't cheat on me even in your dream, okay?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が、うふふ、と笑った。
dialogues.en:
"I can't control my dreams, don't talk about it so
seriously...... Huh? What's this?"
dialogues.text:
"I can't control my dreams, don't talk about it so
seriously...... Huh? What's this?"

dialogues.en: I found cherry blossom petals falling off of my bedding.
dialogues.text: I found cherry blossom petals falling off of my bedding.

dialogues.jp: いつからだろう？
dialogues.en: I guess it could happen since the bed's by the window.
dialogues.text: I guess it could happen since the bed's by the window.

dialogues.jp:
こんな弱々しい笑みしか浮かべられなくなった
のは。
dialogues.en: "Was the window open?"
dialogues.text: "Was the window open?"

dialogues.jp: どうしてだろう？
dialogues.en:
I think I kept it closed since Nemu was complaining about
her allergy.
dialogues.text:
I think I kept it closed since Nemu was complaining about
her allergy.

dialogues.jp: こんなふうになってしまったのは。
dialogues.en: "Oops, sorry. I guess the outside air isn't good for you."
dialogues.text: "Oops, sorry. I guess the outside air isn't good for you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……ね、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. I came in because I wanted to."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. I came in because I wanted to."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「離れないでね」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Then I'll see you later......"
dialogues.text: "Okay. Then I'll see you later......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私の側にずっと……」
dialogues.en: "Is this embarrassed feeling yours?"
dialogues.text: "Is this embarrassed feeling yours?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ずっと？」
dialogues.en: "I'll let you say that."
dialogues.text: "I'll let you say that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: My heart ached.
dialogues.text: My heart ached.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: Maybe it's a dream.
dialogues.text: Maybe it's a dream.

dialogues.jp:
もう珍しくもなんともなかった。急に、音夢が
眠りに落ちてしまうのなんて。
dialogues.en: I stopped my breath at this most beautiful scene.
dialogues.text: I stopped my breath at this most beautiful scene.

dialogues.jp: 「ほんと……なんでなんだろうなぁ」
dialogues.en: I saw it here and there.
dialogues.text: I saw it here and there.

dialogues.jp:
その場に崩れ落ちるようにして、俺は座り込ん
だ。
dialogues.en: Like blood stains.
dialogues.text: Like blood stains.

dialogues.jp: ◆間違った選択肢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Somebody else's dream◆
dialogues.text: ◆Somebody else's dream◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢が桜の花びらを吐き出すようになってから、
音夢と一緒にいるという俺の毎日は変わった。
dialogues.en:
I stayed home all day and did the chores since I decided to
stay with Nemu.
dialogues.text:
I stayed home all day and did the chores since I decided to
stay with Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
音夢にその花びらを見せないことが日課に加わっ
たのだ。
dialogues.en: Nemu told me that she dreamed someone else's dream.
dialogues.text: Nemu told me that she dreamed someone else's dream.

dialogues.jp:
それがただごとではない事態で、俺がしている
ことは現実逃避でしかないとわかっているのに。
dialogues.en:
And I found cherry blossoms like footprints where Nemu had
walked.
dialogues.text:
And I found cherry blossoms like footprints where Nemu had
walked.

dialogues.jp:
俺にはそれしか選択肢がないんだって思い込ん
でいた。
dialogues.en: April 11th.
dialogues.text: April 11th.
